paras: Sceloporus druckercolini, also known commonly as the graceful mountain tree lizard and lagartija elegante arborícola de montaña in Mexican Spanish, is a species of lizard in the family Phrynosomatidae. The species is endemic to Mexico.
The specific name, druckercolini, is in honor of Mexican scientist René Raúl Drucker-Colín.
S. druckercolini is found in southern Mexico, in the Mexican state of Guerrero.
The preferred natural habitat of S. druckercolini is pine-oak forest, at an altitude of 2,170 m (7,120 ft).
The mode of reproduction of S. druckercolini is unknown.
